statement.p: Consider the following situation in which you borrow money from your cousin:

li.p: On June 1st, you borrowed 1500 dollars from your cousin.
On July 1st, you borrowed 470 more dollars from your cousin.
On August 1st, you paid back 650 dollars to your cousin.
On September 1st, you borrowed another 800 dollars from your cousin.

statement.p: How much money do you owe your cousin now?
